'''The Congars and the Coplins''' are two families from [[Emond's Field]] and the surrounding area that are so intermarried that no one really knows where one family ends and the other begins. They are known throughout the [[Two Rivers]] as complainers and troublemakers.{{ref/book|1|1}}

==Congars==
* [[Bili Congar]] - a [[farmer]] and resident of Emond's Field.
* [[Daise Congar]] - the current [[Wisdom]] of Emond's Field.
* [[Eward Congar]] - a resident of Emond's Field.
* [[Jori Congar]] - a resident of the Two Rivers.
* [[Wit Congar]] - a resident of Emond's Field and Daise's husband.

==Coplins==
* [[Benly Coplin]] - a resident of the Two Rivers.
* [[Calle Coplin]] - a resident of the Two Rivers, and considered to be quite forward.
* [[Dag Coplin]] - a resident of the Two Rivers.
* [[Darl Coplin]] - a farmer in Emond's Field and Hari's brother.
* [[Ewal Coplin]] - a resident of Emond's Field.
* [[Hari Coplin]] - a farmer in Emond's Field and Darl's brother.
